description: Lists the events (limited-time activities) of a game server: status now (open, upcoming or closed), open and close times, whether a rerun. By default the open and upcoming events with their stage IDs (for get_stage_drops), or the latest 3 if there are none; open_only=false lists every event, latest first, with stage counts only. The main story and the permanent side stories are not events.

lang.description: Language of the names in the result: the language the user writes in, zh, en, ja or ko (en for other languages, and if omitted).

limit.description: Most events to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

open_only.description: true (default): the events open or upcoming on the server, with their stages; if there are none, the latest 3. false: every event of the server, latest first, without their stages.

server.description: Game server the user plays on: CN (mainland China: 国服, 官服, B服), US (global, English: 国际服, 美服), JP (日服) or KR (韩服). Stages, events and drop rates differ by server. Use the server the user named or the conversation makes clear; a user writing Chinese, Japanese or Korean most likely plays CN, JP or KR. If you can't tell, ask the user which server they play on before calling. Name the server in your answer.

name: list_events

closeTime.description: When the event closes on the server, RFC 3339 in UTC

isRerun.description: Whether the event is the rerun (复刻) of an earlier one

openTime.description: When the event opens on the server, RFC 3339 in UTC

stages.description: The stages of the event, with open_only only

status.description: open, upcoming or closed on the server at now

now.description: The time of the statuses, RFC 3339 in UTC

attribution.description: The credit to give wherever this data is used

url.description: The page of this data on Penguin Statistics, or its home page

truncated.description: Whether limit left out older events

title: List events
